justification.why_now: PLAN v2 (2026-09-04): L3 fired (1.44645 > 0.937) after L2 closed coverage (0.998), so the pipeline's 0.41 excess over the measured floor 1.03662 must be attributed per target before any retrain. MT is 44% of the constant error budget and does not depend on fascicles. The CSV holds mt_mm from the scored sub_pipeline_a1.csv on 131 images (178 already at the median) with PA/FL at the probed medians. No model run; one slot. Policy: <=2 ladder submissions per UTC day; L1 used 1 on 2026-09-04.
justification.expected_benefit: Attributes MT's share of the excess. If MT is right on test the score drops 0.10-0.25 below 1.0366 and MT becomes the first measured target we ship; if not, the aponeurosis pair / scale is the fault and L6 (scale lookup) is promoted before L7/L8.
justification.expected_score_delta: -0.10 to -0.25 vs 1.03662 if measured MT beats the median; > 0 if it does not
justification.falsifier: public > 1.03662 -> measured MT is worse than the median on the 131 measured images; aponeurosis pair selection / scale is wrong on test; promote L6 and do not use measured MT until it passes
justification.mechanism: .venv/bin/kaggle competitions submit -c umud-challenge-muscle-architecture-in-ultrasound-data -f outputs/sub_L4_isolate_mt.csv -m 'L4a isolation: measured MT from sub_pipeline_a1, PA/FL at probed medians (floor 1.03662)'
